runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
The memo that now governs is **OMB M-25-22, *Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government*** (April 2025). It provides guidance to agencies to improve their ability to acquire AI responsibly.

The earlier acquisition memo, **M-24-18**, was withdrawn and superseded. M-25-22 states that it rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-18, Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government. Because M-25-22 explicitly replaces M-24-18, M-25-22 is the operative acquisition policy, and M-24-18 should no longer be relied on.

I based this on the first page of M-25-22 and did not read the rest of that memo, so I can't describe its specific requirements here.
